hero.title: Twitch in your language, with all your emotes
hero.text: A free extension that dubs the stream into your language in real time and draws 7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and each Decatron community's emotes in the chat. It only changes what you see and hear.
hero.note: Free. No account. Only asks for permission on twitch.tv.

demo.caption: The Decatron button shows up next to the player's gear and opens the panel.
demo.chatCaption: Type ":" and the first letters to pick an emote without leaving the chat.

modules.title: Two modules you turn on and off

translation.title: Live translation
translation.text: On channels that offer it, hear the streamer dubbed into your language with captions, while their original voice stays in the background. Only you hear it: the channel and everyone else stay the same.

emotes.title: Emotes from everywhere
emotes.text: See 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in the chat, each Decatron community's own emotes and the platform's global set, without installing other extensions. With a picker when you type ":".

points.title: Channel points
points.text: Automatically claim channel points. On the way.

install.title: Install the extension
install.text: It's added to your browser and only acts on twitch.tv. No account, no data.

open.title: Open a Twitch channel
open.text: The Decatron button appears next to the player's gear. Emotes already show in the chat.

use.title: Pick and enjoy
use.text: On a channel with translation, choose your language: the translated voice plays over the original one, with captions. Each module can be turned off from the panel.

private.title: Only you see and hear it
private.text: Everything happens in your browser. The streamer changes nothing on their broadcast and other viewers don't notice.

noaccount.title: No account, no tracking
noaccount.text: No sign-up and no ads. Your preferences live in your own browser.

open.title: Open source
open.text: The code is published and can be reviewed. Not minified, no surprises.

global.title: Decatron's global set
global.text: Platform emotes that show in every channel's chat. If you'd like to contribute yours, you can request access.

streamers.title: Are you a streamer?
streamers.text: Turn on live translation from your Decatron dashboard, install the desktop app that captures your microphone and pick the languages. Viewers from other countries hear you in theirs. You manage your community's own emotes from the emotes panel.

privacy.title: Extension privacy
points: The extension only runs on twitch.tv pages. It asks for no account, has no ads and collects no personal data.
Translation: it sends decatron.net the name of the channel you are watching and the language you picked, to receive that channel's translation.

Emotes: to show emotes it asks decatron.net (Decatron's own and global emotes), 7tv.io, api.betterttv.net and api.frankerfacez.com (their emotes) and gql.twitch.tv (to get the channel's identifier) about the channel name. Only the channel you are watching is sent.

The extension reads the chat text only inside your browser, to draw emotes and to power the picker that opens when you type ":". That text, what you type and your messages are never sent to any server.
Your preferences (language, background volume, captions, active modules) and a temporary copy of the emote lists are kept in your browser's storage and are deleted when you uninstall the extension.

As with any website, the servers it connects to (decatron.net, 7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and Twitch) can see your IP address when they receive the request. On decatron.net those technical logs are kept for up to 30 days and are not used to identify or profile you.
The translated audio and text are generated from the streamer's voice, with their express authorization when they turn the feature on.
No advertising, no selling of data, and no use of data for anything unrelated to how the extension works.
